usfs.name: USDA Forest Service EDW 2023 Fire Perimeter
usfs.query: Exact uniqfireid values for the seven non-Hayden matched validation cases; outFields contained attributes only; returnGeometry=false.
usfs.scope_note: The layer description says daily/final mapped perimeters are maintained for Forest Service fires with FIRESTAT records; this is not a complete national incident archive.

nifc.name: NIFC WFIGS Interagency Fire Perimeters public FeatureServer
nifc.query: Candidate names limited to the eight frozen validation cases and attr_FireDiscoveryDateTime in calendar 2023; output attributes only; returnGeometry=false. Results were cross-checked by attr_UniqueFireIdentifier, state/unit, local incident identifier, and incident size.
nifc.scope_note: The public item describes an ongoing historical perimeter service that is incomplete and restricts its public layer to approved/visible records.

timezone_reference.finding: Esri states that when dateFieldsTimeReference is null, date values are assumed to be UTC; the USFS layer reports null and datesInUnknownTimezone=false. This does not resolve disagreement between USFS numeric timestamps and local-time flight comments.

summary.interpretation: Public services provide a small number of final-shape candidates useful for later map QA. They do not provide a reliable dated sequence of observed fire growth for this validation cohort.

usfs.comment: IR Flight 8/30/2023 @2252 MDT; N350FV TK-9; acres geodesic UTM Zone 12

cases.assessment: Exact incident/state match; both sources report a final-area scale consistent with FPA-FOD. The USFS timestamp/comment has an unresolved six-hour timezone discrepancy.
Exact incident/state/local-number match and close final-area agreement in NIFC. Geometry and its spatial placement were not inspected.
Exact incident/state/local-number match and close final-area agreement in both services. Geometry and its spatial placement were not inspected.
USFS has one size-matching daily perimeter record, not a sequence. Its time field is not independently tied to a survey timestamp by the available comment.

The exact incident candidate is confirmed. NIFC geometry-area attribute is inconsistent with its own incident size; separate USFS final-area attributes match FPA-FOD. Do not trust the NIFC shape without geometry QA.

The NIFC incident attributes match, but this row has no perimeter acreage or polygon time. A later extent-only query returned a server-side bounding rectangle; the full geometry still needs QA before spatial use.
Exact incident/state/local-number match and close final-area agreement in both services. The USFS timestamp/comment has an unresolved six-hour timezone discrepancy.
Exact incident candidate is confirmed, but the NIFC final geometry-area attribute is only 200 acres against a 10,064-acre incident size. Require geometry/source QA before using it.

limitations: This screen requested no new public perimeter geometry. The earlier Hayden feature page was viewed as noted in usfs-hayden-final-perimeter-screen-20261102.json; its shape was not saved or spatially processed.
Exact name/date/state/local incident identifiers establish a crosswalk candidate, not spatial correctness of a perimeter.
Final mapped perimeters do not provide historical spread progression or the ignition/start perimeter.
USFS numeric perimeter times for Hayden and Pass match local MDT clock readings but are six hours earlier if interpreted as UTC; the producer must clarify the source semantics.
The 2024 TEST split was not queried or opened. No simulation, policy evaluation, or training was performed.
